Players Committee card image of [[Jakku: Rey's Encampment (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3), marked “E1”; pixel for pixel the high-resolution image first published on 26 August 2022 (holotable commit 3ed4308, “GEMP Series 4 AIs, fixes”). The file holds PNG data under a .gif name on the PC site.

Edits: none (file bytes as in that commit).
